title: A/R Detail: the PDF prints a credit's amount in brackets with a minus sign
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a customer with only an unused credit memo, credit memo A, of $150.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only that customer ticked in the Customer filter.
custom_steps:
1. Expand the bucket that holds credit memo A.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the PDF and read credit memo A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Credit memo A's Amount and Open Balance read "$-150.00".

Step 2:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 3:

  • Credit memo A's Amount and Open Balance print as "(-$150.00)": in brackets, with the minus sign before the dollar sign.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R7a: “The PDF uses the app-wide report PDF format, the same as Sales By Customer and Inventory Value: a negative amount prints in brackets with a minus sign, for example "(-$11,111.00)", and dates print as "Nov 04 2026". On screen a negative amount reads "$-11,111.00", as today.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.
